items.name: Road to Hana
items.description: A winding coastal drive past waterfalls, black sand beaches, and rainforest. Start early to beat the traffic.

items.name: Haleakala Crater
items.description: Watch the sunrise above the clouds from the summit of a dormant volcano. Sunrise visits need a reservation.

items.name: Molokini Crater
items.description: A half-sunken volcanic crater with clear water, tropical fish, and sea turtles. Reached by boat tour.

items.name: Zion National Park
items.description: Hike the Narrows through a slot canyon river or climb to the view at Angels Landing.

items.name: Arches National Park
items.description: Over 2,000 natural stone arches, including the famous Delicate Arch at sunset.

items.name: Bryce Canyon
items.description: A canyon filled with orange rock spires called hoodoos. Sunrise Point lives up to its name.

items.name: Central Park
items.description: Walk the Mall, rent a rowboat on the lake, or picnic on the Great Lawn.

items.name: Statue of Liberty
items.description: Take the ferry to Liberty Island for close-up views and a stop at Ellis Island.

items.name: The Met
items.description: One of the largest art museums in the world, with collections spanning 5,000 years.
